wacamera.command.help:
/wac cam : append the current view using the next number
/wac cam <number> : set that point to the current view
/wac cam <number> <x> <y> <z> <yaw> <pitch> : set explicit lens coordinates and angles
/wac goto <number> : move to a point with its orientation (teleport permission required)
Numbers start at 1 and are consecutive. Save via K > Shot > Save settings.
